what: Every time the mouse moves 80px over the panel, one sticker (image) appears at a trailing point (.1 per frame) at 0 scale, slides to the cursor position over .4s power2.out while growing to 1 scale, and the inner image pops out shrinking from 2.5 scale to 1. After .45s it shrinks to .2 scale over .4s and disappears. It always stacks on top, and the image set is reused in rotation

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Stickers/photos to cycle through (multiple, required) — the original has 24 (12 kinds twice)
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Image inside the item that shrinks from 2.5 to 1 (first child if none)
options.gap: Mouse travel distance (px) that places a new section, default 80
options.lerp: Share the late-following dot covers (per frame), default .1
options.hold: Time after appearing before it starts to fade (sec), default .45
options.fx:drop: Event each element fires whenever a sheet is laid down (sound effect slot)

note: Does nothing on devices without a mouse and with reduced motion

from.where: Sticker trail on the about.js social section (original AboutImageTrail — 24 images · threshold 80 · lerp .1 · .4 power2.out · inner 2.5→1 · at .45 scales to .2 over .4)
